# 2026-09-12

Landed 08:55, wrecked. Train to Centraal took 15 minutes. The DoubleTree first
gave us 512 on the 5th floor, facing the tracks; the front desk (Ruben) moved
us to **room 914 on the 9th floor**, a corner king with a huge window over the
IJ. Gold status paid off. Napped, walked the waterfront, Negronis at the
SkyLounge on the 11th floor at sunset.
